## Goal

Make "won a game" a first-class, engine-generic achievement event so the give-away triggers have a real, Steam-free source.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AchievementSystem` (or a documented thin extension) gains an idempotent game-outcome surface (e.g. `onGameOutcome({ gameId, outcome })`) that unlocks mapped achievements via the existing `AchievementSink`; zero Steam/Electron imports.
- The launcher manifest defines `first-win` and `second-distinct-game-win` meta-achievements (titles, descriptions, hidden flags) and the outcome-to-achievement mapping is engine-generic.
- "Second distinct game" logic only unlocks after wins in two different game ids; re-wins of the same game do not.
- `SteamAchievementService` idempotence and offline paths are reused unchanged for the meta-achievements.
- Unit tests cover outcome-to-unlock, distinct-game counting, idempotence, and no-op for unknown outcomes; pass under `--project unit`.

## Key Files

- `src/core-engine/AchievementSystem.ts`
- `src/core-engine/index.ts`
- `electron/achievement-manifest.json`
- `tests/steam-achievements/achievement-outcome.test.ts` (new)

## Deliverables

Engine outcome surface, manifest meta-achievements, unit tests.

data.description:
## Goal

Author the **failing** unit tests that pin the contract of the pure event-log formatter before the module exists (TDD red step for CG-0MVTTR0OC006PWDK).

## Scope

- New `tests/ui/debug/formatEventLog.test.ts` (Vitest `unit` project, no Phaser import).
- Target module `src/ui/debug/formatEventLog.ts` (created by the sibling implementation item) exposing:
  - `formatEventLogEntry({ timestamp, eventName, payload })` → one-line header `"<timestamp> [<eventName>]"`, then `"
"`, then the pretty-printed payload body.
  - `stringifyPayloadSafe(payload, indent = 2)` → pretty JSON, safe on non-serialisable values.
  - `widestLineLength(text)` → character length of the longest rendered line (used for the horizontal-scroll fallback estimate).

## Cases (all required)

1. Nested object **and** array payload → multi-line output, 2-space indentation, every key present.
2. Long single value (a string > 200 characters) → the complete value appears; no `...` truncation; rendered length ≥ the raw value length.
3. Primitives (`42`, `"text"`, `true`, `null`) → readable single-line body, no throw.
4. `undefined` payload → documented fallback (`'undefined'`), no throw.
5. Empty object `{}` → body is `{}`.
6. Circular reference (`const a: any = {}; a.self = a`) → no throw, documented placeholder (e.g. `[Circular]`), and a sibling non-circular value still serialises.
7. Output shape: exactly one header line containing the timestamp and bracketed event name; every later line belongs to the JSON body.
8. `widestLineLength` returns the maximum line length and ignores trailing newlines.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Formatting is pure and unit-tested: the test file pins every case above with meaningful assertions, so the formatter's public contract is fixed before implementation.
- [ ] The formatting logic is extracted into a Phaser-free helper: the test imports only `src/ui/debug/formatEventLog.ts` and contains no Phaser import.
- [ ] Non-serialisable payloads degrade safely: `undefined`, `null`, primitives and a circular structure all render without throwing through the documented fallback.
- [ ] The test is unit-tested for nested objects and arrays, primitives, `undefined`, an empty object, a circular reference, multi-line output shape, and the absence of truncation.
- [ ] Red then green: the suite fails only because `src/ui/debug/formatEventLog.ts` does not exist yet, and passes unchanged once the implementation item lands.
- [ ] Build and targeted suites pass: `npm run build` succeeds and the unit suite covering `src/ui/debug` passes (run through the test skill, never an ad-hoc `vitest` invocation).

## Verification

- `/skill:test --type unit` (never run `vitest` directly — AGENTS.md test-execution policy).
- `npm run build`.

## Key Files

- `tests/ui/debug/formatEventLog.test.ts`

**Parent:** CG-0MVTTR0OC006PWDK — AC1, AC4, AC6, AC7

data.description:
## Goal

Extract the event-payload formatting out of `GameEventLogOverlay.ts` into a pure, Phaser-free module so it can be unit-tested and reused, turning the red tests green.

## Scope

- New `src/ui/debug/formatEventLog.ts`:
  - `stringifyPayloadSafe(payload, indent = 2)`: `JSON.stringify` with a `WeakSet` replacer that replaces repeated/circular references with a documented `'[Circular]'` placeholder; `undefined`/functions/symbols fall back to `String(payload)`; any thrown error is caught and also falls back to `String(payload)`. Never throws.
  - `formatEventLogEntry(entry)`: `"<timestamp> [<eventName>]" + "
" + stringifyPayloadSafe(entry.payload)`.
  - `widestLineLength(text)`: longest line length, `?
` split, ignores trailing newlines.
  - JSDoc on every export stating the non-serialisable fallback contract.
- `src/ui/debug/index.ts`: re-export the formatter helpers (part of the debug-tools surface).
- No behaviour change in `GameEventLogOverlay.ts` yet — this item only lands the pure module (the overlay item consumes it).
- Do not refactor `SessionExportTool.ts`; note in a code comment that its inline `JSON.stringify(…, null, 2)` could adopt the helper later (out of scope).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Full payload pretty-printed: the formatter emits indented multi-line JSON (`JSON.stringify(payload, replacer, 2)`) under a one-line header of `timestamp [eventName]`, with no 80-character truncation anywhere in the module.
- [ ] Non-serialisable payloads degrade safely: `undefined`, `null`, primitives, functions and circular structures render without throwing, using the documented `String(payload)` / `[Circular]` fallbacks.
- [ ] Formatting is pure and unit-tested: the module has zero Phaser and zero scene dependencies, and the sibling unit-test item passes against it unchanged.
- [ ] Code comments/JSDoc document the header format, indentation, and each fallback path.
- [ ] Build and targeted suites pass: `npm run build` succeeds and the unit suite covering `src/ui/debug` passes (run through the test skill).

## Verification

- `/skill:test --type unit`.
- `npm run build`.

## Key Files

- `src/ui/debug/formatEventLog.ts`
- `src/ui/debug/index.ts`
- `tests/ui/debug/formatEventLog.test.ts`

**Parent:** CG-0MVTTR0OC006PWDK — AC1, AC4, AC6, AC7
